ASSA For the Petitioner(s) : Mr. N. Alam, Advocate
For the Respondent(s) : Ms. N. Bordoloi, SC, Revenue
Mr. H. Sarmah, Addl. Sr. GA
BEFORE  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEVASHIS BARUAH  ORDER 31.03.2026
Issue notice making it returnable on 13.05.2026.

2. Ms. N. Bordoloi, the learned counsel accepts notice on behalf of the Respondent No.1 and Mr. H.
Sarmah, the learned counsel accepts notice on behalf of the Respondent No.2.

Extra copies of the writ petition be served upon them by tomorrow, i.e. 01.04.2026.
3.

This Court is however not inclined to issue notice upon the Respondent Nos.3, 4 & 5 taking into account that the dispute in the instant proceedings is only limited to the inaction on the part of the Respondent No.2 for taking steps as required under Page No.# 3/4 Sections 19 & 20 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
4.

It is the case of the petitioner that the land of the petitioner was acquired by the Respondent Authorities for construction of a four lane National Highway No.37, and accordingly, Land Acquisition Case bearing LA Case No.13/2007 was registered and an Award was passed sometime in the year 2012.

Thereupon, on the ground that the compensation so awarded was inadequate, the petitioner filed a writ petition before this Court which was registered and numbered as WP(C)
No.8219/2019.
5.

This Court vide an order dated 16.02.2024 granted liberty to the petitioner to submit an application under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 within 42 days from the date of the said order and with a further direction that if such application is filed, the District Commissioner shall in terms with Section 19 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 make a reference to the Court of the District Judge, Kamrup (Metro) forthwith and not later than 30 days from the date of such M/S Maheshwari Industries vs The State Of Assam And 4 Ors on 31 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173009057/
2 application.
6.

entities.text: M/S Maheshwari Industries vs The State Of Assam And 4
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is the case of the petitioner that on 16.03.2024, such application was filed, but till date no steps in that regard have been taken by the District Commissioner, Kamrup (Metro).

It is under such circumstances, the present writ petition has been Page No.# 4/4 filed.
7.

The Respondent No.2 herein is directed to apprise this Court as to why a reference has not been made pursuant to the application submitted by the petitioner seeking a reference in terms with Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, and more particularly, within the period as permitted by this Court vide the order dated 16.02.2024 in WP(C) No.8219/2019.
8.

The said response be brought on record by filing an affidavit on or before 06.05.2026.
9.
List accordingly.
